name: Human-MME
description: Human-MME is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on human-centric scene understanding, covering diverse human scenes and progressive evaluation dimensions from granular perception to higher-dimensional causal reasoning with nearly 20,000 real-world image-question pairs.
typical_sota_score: varies by subtask; typically ~60–95% (higher on perceptual/multiple-choice items, substantially lower on higher-order causal reasoning)
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for human-centric multimodal reasoning that is gaining attention, but is not yet as widely established as older multimodal benchmarks.
notes: Includes automated and human annotation pipelines; supports multi-person and multi-image understanding with diverse question types.
